dialogue.content: こんばんは。今日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for coming today.

dialogue.content: こんばんは、よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Good evening. Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたら、始めたいと思いますので、もうしばらくお待ちください。
dialogue.English: We will begin at the scheduled time, so please wait just a little longer.

dialogue.content: 了解しました
dialogue.English: Understood.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日は、どの様なご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I am your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 誰も友達もいないし、一人で孤独で
dialogue.English: I don't have any friends, and I'm all alone and lonely.

dialogue.content: やりたいこともなく、学校に行くのがつらいです
dialogue.English: I don't have anything I want to do, and it's hard for me to go to school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは、お寂しいですね。ご相談にきて頂いて、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. That must feel lonely. Thank you for reaching out today.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校というのは、学年をお聞きしても良いでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned school; may I ask what grade you're in?

dialogue.content: 高1です
dialogue.English: I'm a freshman in high school.

dialogue.content: そうですか。いつからそんな風に感じる様になったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. When did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.content: わりと小さいころから人と話すのは苦手でした
dialogue.English: I've had trouble talking to people ever since I was quite young.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。小さい頃は、どんな風に思っていましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. What was it like for you when you were little?

dialogue.content: 話したいのに話せないし、人と接するのがとても苦手でした
dialogue.English: I wanted to talk to people but couldn't, and I was really bad at interacting with them.

dialogue.content: ええ。話したかったんですね。なのに上手くいかなかった。もどかしい思いでしたね。
dialogue.English: Yes. You wanted to talk, but it didn't go well. That must have been frustrating.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし、良かったら、貴方をなんと呼べばいいか、教えて貰えますか？それと、性別をよかったら・・
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you tell me what I should call you? And your gender as well, if you're comfortable...

dialogue.content: みか女
dialogue.English: Mika, female.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。みかさんですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you, Mika.

dialogue.content: みかさんは、今の状況が、どうなればいいな、と思っていますか？
dialogue.English: Mika, what would you like to see happen with your current situation?

dialogue.content: 友達が出来て、毎日楽しく学校に行けたらいいです
dialogue.English: I'd like to make friends and be able to enjoy going to school every day.

dialogue.content: ええ。そうですね。どうすれば、そんな風になるかを、一緒に考えてみましょうね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. Let's think together about how we can make that happen.

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 今、学校生活で一番困っているのは、どんな事ですか？お友達がいない事？それともやりたい事が無い事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What is the biggest challenge for you in your school life right now? Is it not having friends? Or is it not having anything you want to do?

dialogue.content: クラスメイトと話したいけど話せないことです
dialogue.English: It's that I want to talk to my classmates, but I can't.

dialogue.content: 少し話しかけてくれても
dialogue.English: Even when they try to talk to me a little...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 私が上手く話しが出来ず
dialogue.English: I can't carry on the conversation well,

dialogue.content: すぐ会話が終わってしまって
dialogue.English: and the conversation ends right away.

dialogue.content: もう話しかけてくれなくなりました
dialogue.English: Now they've stopped talking to me.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。それは、辛かったですね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must have been painful for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話かけてくれた人は、何人もいたの？
dialogue.English: Were there many people who tried to talk to you?

dialogue.content: いいえ多くは無いですが、席の周りの数人の女子が話しかけてくれました
dialogue.English: No, not many, but a few of the girls sitting near me did.

dialogue.content: その時、どんな気持ちでしたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel at that time?

dialogue.content: 最初は嬉しかったですが
dialogue.English: I was happy at first, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 話が続かず、話しかけてくれなくなったのでとてもつらかったです
dialogue.English: it was very painful when the conversation wouldn't continue and they stopped talking to me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。本当は、お友達と楽しく話したいと思っていたんですものね。
dialogue.English: I see. Because you truly wanted to have fun conversations with friends, didn't you?

dialogue.content: はい、どうしても長く話すことが出来ません・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, I just can't seem to talk for long...

dialogue.content: 発達障害のようです
dialogue.English: I think I may have a developmental disorder.

dialogue.content: そんな風に思うのは、どんな事でそう感じるのかな？
dialogue.English: What makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 母が調べてそう言っています
dialogue.English: My mother looked it up and said so.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。という事は、病院に行ったのではないですよね？
dialogue.English: I see. So that means you haven't been to a hospital, correct?

dialogue.content: はい、病院は行ってません
dialogue.English: That's right, I haven't been to a hospital.

dialogue.content: お母さんにそういわれた時、どんな気持ちでしたか？
dialogue.English: How did you feel when your mother told you that?

dialogue.content: うすうす気づいてはいましたが、やっぱりかと思いました
dialogue.English: I had a faint suspicion, so I just thought, 'I knew it.'

dialogue.content: ショックでした
dialogue.English: I was shocked.

dialogue.content: それは、びっくりしましたね。発達障害だから中々上手く人と話せないのだと、ご自分でも思っているという事でしょうか？
dialogue.English: That must have been surprising. Do you think it's because of a developmental disorder that you have trouble talking to people?

dialogue.content: はいそうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 発達障害かどうかは、心配なら病院で診察してもらわないといけないと思うのですが・・でも、みかさんは、お友達と話したい、と思っている訳だから、どうしたら、お友達と少しでも話せるようになるか、考えてみませんか？
dialogue.English: If you're worried about whether or not it's a developmental disorder, I think you would need to see a doctor for a diagnosis... But since you want to talk with friends, Mika, shall we think about how you might be able to talk with them, even just a little?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: みかさんが、今、学校で、話てみたいな、と思ってる人はいますか？
dialogue.English: Mika, is there anyone at school right now that you'd like to try talking to?

dialogue.content: 話せて友達になれるなら、誰でもいいです
dialogue.English: If I can talk to them and become friends, anyone would be fine.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。みかさんの気持ちが伝わってきます。お話が出来る人がいると、嬉しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. I can really sense how much that means to you. It's nice to have someone to talk to, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、嬉しいですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it would be nice.

dialogue.content: もし、今度誰かが話かけてくれたら、なんて、言いたいですか？みかさんからでも、何て声をかけれそうかな？
dialogue.English: If someone starts a conversation with you next time, what would you like to say? Or on your end, what do you think you could say to start one?

dialogue.content: 話しかけてくれたら、それにこたえて話したいと思いますが、どうしても長く話せないんです
dialogue.English: If someone talks to me, I'd like to respond and talk with them, but I just can't keep the conversation going for long.

dialogue.content: 話しかけるのは、ハードルたかいなと思っています
dialogue.English: Starting a conversation myself feels like a high hurdle.

dialogue.content: そうですね。長いお話をいきなりするのは、ちょっと不安もありますよね。では、「おはよう！」とか、挨拶はどうだろう？今、挨拶は、どんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: I understand. Suddenly trying to have a long conversation can be a bit nerve-wracking, can't it? Well then, what about a greeting, like 'Good morning!'? How are you with greetings right now?

dialogue.content: 今はあいさつも出来ていません…
dialogue.English: At the moment, I can't even manage greetings...

dialogue.content: 周りの子たちは私が話すの苦手な人って思っていると思います
dialogue.English: I think the kids around me think I'm not good at talking.

dialogue.content: そうですか。ちょっと勇気がいるよね。でも、もし、みかさんが「おはよう」っていわれたら、どんな気持ちになりそうですか？
dialogue.English: I see. It takes a bit of courage, doesn't it? But if someone said 'Good morning' to you, Mika, how do you think you would feel?

dialogue.content: 嬉しいと思います
dialogue.English: I think I'd be happy.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きっと周りの人達も嬉しいと思いますよ。いきなりお話出来なくても、挨拶だけでも、どうでしょう。おはよう、って言って、おはようって返ってきたら、嬉しいよね。
dialogue.English: I'm sure the people around you would be happy too. Even if you can't have a conversation right away, how about just a greeting? If you say 'Good morning,' and they say 'Good morning' back, that would feel nice, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: そうですねでもその後が続かなかったらどうしようって思います
dialogue.English: That's true, but I worry about what to do if the conversation doesn't continue after that.

dialogue.content: 不安になります
dialogue.English: It makes me anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね。不安になるし、ちょっと勇気もいると思います。みかさんが嬉しいと思う様に、お友達もきっとあいさつして貰ったら嬉しいと思うし、もし、もっと話したい、と思ったら、話すのがちょっと苦手だけど、お友達になりたい、と気持ちを言ってみるのも一つかな、と思うんですけれど、どうでしょう？もし、みかさんがお友達にそういわれたら、どんな気持ちかな？
dialogue.English: I understand. It can make you anxious, and I think it takes some courage. Just like you would feel happy, I'm sure your classmates would be happy to be greeted too. And if you feel like you want to talk more, I think one option could be to share your feelings, saying something like, 'I'm a little awkward at talking, but I'd like to be friends.' What do you think? If a classmate said that to you, Mika, how would you feel?

dialogue.content: 友達が出来るなら、それは嬉しいと思います
dialogue.English: If I could make a friend that way, I think I'd be happy.

dialogue.content: ええ。挨拶ならどうかな？まずは、そこから。
dialogue.English: I see. So what about a greeting? Let's start there.

dialogue.content: はい、挨拶してその後話が続かなかったらどうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: Okay, what should I do if I say a greeting and the conversation doesn't continue afterwards?

dialogue.content: また離れていかないかな…
dialogue.English: I wonder if they'll drift away again...

dialogue.content: そうですね。相手の人がどうするかは分からないけど、自分の出来る挨拶を毎日笑顔でしてみたら、話すのが苦手でも大丈夫、とおもってくれる人がいるかもしれないと思うんですけど、どうでしょう？
dialogue.English: That's a valid concern. We don't know how the other person will react, but if you try giving the best greeting you can with a smile every day, I think there might be someone who understands that it's okay even if you're not great at talking. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうなんですかね
dialogue.English: Do you really think so?

dialogue.content: そう思ってくれる人いますかね？
dialogue.English: Would someone really think that?

dialogue.content: みかさんは、どう思いますか？
dialogue.English: What do you think, Mika?

dialogue.content: うーん、やってみないと分からないと思いますが
dialogue.English: Hmm, I guess I won't know unless I try, but...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: かなり勇気がいりますね
dialogue.English: It takes a lot of courage.

dialogue.content: そうですね。お友達とお話したい、と思ってるみかさんなら、「おはよう」って言える日が来るように思うんですが、どうでしょう。
dialogue.English: It does. But since you want to talk with friends, Mika, I believe the day will come when you can say 'Good morning.' What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、言える日きますかね。頑張ってみます
dialogue.English: I see... I wonder if that day will come. I'll try my best.

dialogue.content: ええ。応援しています。
dialogue.English: Yes. I'll be rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 相談の終了時間となりました。今日はこれで終わりますが、また、いつでもご相談にいらしたくださいね。
dialogue.English: Our time for the session is now up. We'll end here for today, but please feel free to come back for another session anytime.

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: （終了いたします。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (This concludes the session. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした！有難うございました)
dialogue.English: (Good work! Thank you very much.)
